# Blazium Games

> Blazium Games is a game publishing platform, with an infrastructure focus.
> Full documentation for language models: https://docs.blazium.games/llms-full.txt

## Start here

Other indexes: https://blazium.games/llms.txt and https://mcp.blazium.games/llms.txt.

Prefer the structured MCP servers over scraping HTML: [developer](https://mcp.blazium.games/developer) and [player](https://mcp.blazium.games/player).

### 1. Which server

The developer server is https://mcp.blazium.games/developer. https://mcp.blazium.games/mcp is the same server. Use it for pages, builds, analytics, crashes, keys, and payouts. The player server is https://mcp.blazium.games/player. Use it for search, the library, purchases, and installs. A token belongs to one server. A developer key starts with `bgames_mcp_`. A player key starts with `bgames_play_`.

### 2. Connect

Add the URL only. Leave Authorization out of this config.

Cursor `mcp.json` for the developer server:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "blazium-games": {
      "url": "https://mcp.blazium.games/developer"
    }
  }
}
```

Cursor `mcp.json` for the player server:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "blazium-games-player": {
      "url": "https://mcp.blazium.games/player"
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Code:

```
claude mcp add --transport http blazium-games https://mcp.blazium.games/developer
claude mcp add --transport http blazium-games-player https://mcp.blazium.games/player
```

VS Code: MCP: Add Server, HTTP, then that server's URL.

### 3. Sign in, no bearer

Call `initialize` with no token. `tools/list`, `prompts/list`, `prompts/get`, `resources/list`, and `resources/templates/list` are readable before sign-in. Then `prompts/get`:

- `setup_account` for a new person. Call `create_account`, then `confirm_account` with the email code.
- `sign_in` for a person who already has an account. Call `login`, then `confirm_account` when the answer is `otp_required`.

### 4. What the human does

Send `accept_legal`, and on the developer server `accept_developer_terms`, only after the person agrees. Do not invent a password. `create_account` shows Continue or Generate only when the call has no password. `login` never offers Generate. An authenticator challenge, and choosing or skipping an authenticator, stay on https://blazium.games/account/finish. The agent does not accept terms or skip an authenticator.

### 5. The key

`confirm_account` returns that server's first key once and does not return the website session. A later confirm does not rotate a key that already exists. A later connection calls `elevate_session` with the saved key. A pasted client config may contain `Authorization: Bearer`. The agent does not set that header. It calls `elevate_session`. Do not call the server with Python.

### 6. After sign-in

On the developer server, call `game_setup_walkthrough` and follow `next_tool` through `validate_listing`. MCP never uploads files. Builds, images, and symbols go through the chauffeur CLI: https://docs.blazium.games/docs/cli. On the player server, search and shelves need no account. Buying uses the account balance, the `player:buy` scope, and the person's spending limit. Anything beyond that limit waits for the person.

### 7. When a call fails

- `4105`: developer mode is off. The person turns it on. The player server works without it.
- `4030`: this token is bound to one project and the call is account-level. Use an account token, or stay inside that project.
- `4031`: the token is missing the scope. Ask the person to widen it.
- `4032`: the token mixes developer and player scopes. Use the server that matches the key.
- `4034`: a developer token tried to buy or top up. Use the player server.
- `4212`: this token cannot purchase. Ask the person to allow purchases (`player:buy`).

The live tool list is `tools/list`. The server cards are https://mcp.blazium.games/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json and https://mcp.blazium.games/.well-known/mcp/player-server-card.json.

## The platform

- [Blazium Games](https://blazium.games/): Play and publish games, applications, mods, and assets.
- [Introduction](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/intro): What the platform is and where to start.
- [About](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/about): Who operates the platform, the fixed fee, and where downloads are hosted.
- [FAQ](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/faq): Finding games, the library, a missing purchase, reporting a page, and deleting an account.
- [Blog](https://blazium.games/blog): Published posts. The list API is https://api.blazium.online/api/v1/public/articles and the feed is https://cdn.blazium.online/articles/rss.xml.

## MCP and the player server

- [MCP](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/mcp): The developer server for pages, builds, analytics, and keys. A token belongs to this server or the player server, not both.
- [Player MCP](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/mcp/player): The player server for search, reviews, friends, installs, and purchases. Buys go here.

## Listings

- [Listings](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/listings): Taxonomy, the listing check, image sizes, search, and shelves.
- [Import from Steam](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/steam-import): Copy a Steam store page into a new or existing listing with a Steamworks Web API key.

## Game chat

- [Game chat](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/storefront/chat): IRC at irc.blazium.online (TLS 6697, browser websocket 8000). Sign in with SASL PLAIN: your username and a chat token from Settings > Chat, shown once; regenerating it disconnects the old one. Join a game with GAMEJOIN <game uid>.
- [Chat Rules](https://blazium.games/chat-rules): Anything legal is allowed; nothing illegal; never any harm to children. Chat is not logged.

## Steam auth verification

- [Steam auth verification](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/steam-auth): Trade a Steam session ticket for a session token that proves ownership, then check, refresh, or revoke it from your servers with the game's auth key.

## Anticheat

- [Anticheat](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/anticheat): The owner asks with a contact email. Settings stay closed until staff record a signed NDA and a signed contract. Profiles are generic, platformer, and fps. Dedicated servers use a named key. The player client uses the platform session.

## Payments

- [Payments](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/payments): Selling, buying, the balance, cash-outs (up to 72 business hours to the bank, also by agents), and refunds (donations are not refundable).

## Public API and the editor asset library

- [Public API reference](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/api-reference): Authentication, the envelope, error codes, and rate limits. OpenAPI 3.1 at https://api.blazium.online/api/v1/public/openapi.json.
- [Editor asset library](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/editor-asset-library): The Godot and Blazium AssetLib repository URL, https://api.blazium.online/api/v1/public/asset-library, with optional player sign-in.
- [Anonymous downloads](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/anonymous-downloads): Downloading free projects without an account, and its trade-offs.
- [Download analytics](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/download-analytics): Download sources, access, clients, outcomes, and what is recorded.
- [Browser player](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/web-player): Play a browser pack in the browser, with an optional demo, a Discord activity, and a Telegram Mini App. Mini-game packs are downloaded. Export targets are checks. Blazium does not submit the pack.

## Deploy and crash reporting

- [Deploy builds](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/deploy): Upload builds and symbols from CI.
- [Crash reporting](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/crash-reporting): Crashes and the six standard launch events from a game.
- [Progress](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/progress): Achievements, stats, registered funnel events, and rich presence.

## SEO and discovery

- [SEO and indexing](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/seo-and-indexing): What may be indexed, sitemaps, and share titles.
- [Discovery files](https://docs.blazium.games/docs/discovery): robots.txt, sitemaps, security.txt, the API catalog, and llms.txt.

## Legal and support

- [Privacy Policy](https://blazium.games/privacy-policy): What is collected and how accounts are deleted.
- [Terms of Service](https://blazium.games/terms-of-service): Terms for using Blazium Games.
- [Steam API Disclosure](https://blazium.games/steam-api-disclosure): What is read from Steam for linking, imports, and Steam auth verification.
- [Chat Rules](https://blazium.games/chat-rules): What is allowed in chat, penalties, chat tokens, and what chat keeps.
- [Support](https://blazium.games/support): How to get help.
- [Service status](https://status.blazium.games/): Current status and incidents.
